title: Causality-Aided Trade-off Analysis for Machine Learning Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on analyzing trade-offs between fairness, performance, and robustness in machine learning models, using sensitive attributes like race, sex, and age.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on fairness with respect to non-religious attributes such as race, sex, and age.
